purpose: The platform's test check becomes a reliable gate on HomePc.

authorization.grantedBy: owner (netbka), delegated to the owner's main session
authorization.text: On 2026-10-10 the owner directed: 'resume work. The agents should never stop working. You know the goal. No my review is needed.' This campaign takes netbka/engineering-platform#58 only: make the supervisor test gate reliable under machine load. Test-only change in this repository; the live supervisor, its data directory and deployed runtime are never touched, and nothing is deployed. One worker; a PR only, never merge or deploy. No run cap, no cost ceiling, no repair or retry limit; provider subscription limits and the no-progress guard are the stops. Provider order Claude, then Codex, then Cursor.

constraints: Campaign for netbka/engineering-platform#58 only, authorized by the owner on 2026-10-10. Work only on this packet's task. Do not change other issues' work, other agents' branches or worktrees, campaigns/*.json, or registry and policy files.

Your assigned worktree is the only place you change files. Never touch anything else under D:/Git/engineering-platform/.local (the live supervisor runtime checkout, its data directory, other worktrees), never touch the main checkout D:/Git/engineering-platform, and never start, stop or restart the supervisor, its scheduled tasks or the dashboard. Temporary directories the tests create are fine.
No production access, deployment, GitHub Actions changes, paid services or new recurring spend. Never read or copy .env contents or credentials.
Follow this repository's AGENTS.md: after changing tests or code, run npm install once in your worktree and then npm run check.

Never weaken an assertion, delete a test, mark a failing test as skipped, or broaden a timeout for a logic-only test to make the gate pass. A timing change must be justified by measured runner start-up or heartbeat behaviour under load.
A reviewer must be able to reproduce every claim from your report: include exact commands, pinned SHAs, run counts and pass/fail tallies, and list remaining gaps instead of claiming completion.

tasks.title: Supervisor tests stay reliable under machine load
tasks.outcome: The test check passes or fails for real reasons, not because HomePc is busy.
tasks.goal: Make npm run check a reliable gate on HomePc under load for netbka/engineering-platform#58. Read the issue and all its comments with gh issue view 58 --repo netbka/engineering-platform --comments. Remaining flakes after #70: atomic.test.mjs:11 (expected EPERM did not occur), coordinator.test.mjs (runs lost, 30 s until timeout), supervisor.test.mjs (5 !== 4, likely a starved but healthy runner declared lost under FAST staleMs/startGraceMs of 5 s, plus a retry), restart.test.mjs:93 and process.test.mjs:79 (owned stop) seen in later full runs. For each, find the root cause from runUntil's preserved test-failure.json and the code, then fix it: raise liveness bounds only for tests that spawn real runner processes (keep logic-only tests fast), give coordinator waits the same budget as runUntil, and make the atomic contention deterministic instead of a race.
constraints: Change only tests/** and, when a test exposes a real product bug, the smallest fix in src/supervisor/** with its own regression test; say which in the report.
Measure, don't guess: record runner start-up and heartbeat intervals under load in the report before choosing any new bound.
acceptance: Each listed flake has a stated root cause with evidence and a fix that keeps its assertion intact.

npm run check passes three consecutive full runs in the worktree, at least one while another npm run check runs concurrently to create load, with tallies in the report; logic-only tests keep their fast timings.
The report lists any flake that could not be reproduced or fixed as a remaining gap.
